folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation: represented worlds and later delivery, 2026-11-04 (B370)
folds.body:
The complete audit preserves meaningful represented play rather than equating nine IDs with nine complete source settings. Its workshop pocket, regional harbor, original nested-service cluster, supplied-MTL Paradise-derived branch and Cyorian visit have different depth, era and authority. Two Paradise hubs remain distinct. Nineteen profile definitions are not nineteen activated campaigns, and local places are not additional whole worlds. Destination/command/power counts and native consumer observations belong to the cited source/build snapshot; current capability needs actual present evidence.

Keep the concrete progression relationships: learned method versus mastered application, local source/fuel/body/tool support, refinement after a limit and useful return consequences. A foreign notebook need not export its magical anchor to support a mundane task. Carried actual cargo/borrowed custody, personal travel, accepted mission, extraction readiness, actual arrival and once-only settlement remain separate. Internal carrier metadata alone does not prove a visible block or loss. Travel does not intrinsically heal, refill, convert currencies, copy physiology or grant office, while an actual supported mechanism can do more.

The later home/social owner records the ten-destination/notebook/visit-compaction wave, and the absorption owner records known-route delivery. Those dated results qualify this audit’s earlier missing consumers; they are not newly browser-verified here and do not close every stronger-world, companion/body or general transfer gap. Preserve history and active obligations when compacting; old96/128row limits count records rather than round trips and are not blanket permission to delete played lives. Mature repeat demand still needs actual actors, funds, supplies and time without reentry refills or unpaid off-screen production.

The five priorities remain considerations at their date, not the present build order or universal gate. Current direction/AD51 and specific current owners govern selected work; AD42 makes human review optional. Learn/travel/use/refine/return/reload/revisit is a useful selected acceptance route, not proof already obtained by a registry or source-map match. No source, current world state, clock, server, build, gameplay journey, save or browser check was performed by this review.

folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation: finite source joins and handoff evidence, 2026-11-04 (B370)
folds.body:
This revision2source leaf was released after a finite source-reconciliation task. The moving950-command definition import, historical943-command build and154Frontier-command/seven-ending findings are different input scopes. Existing filed source/implementation and imported definitions do not establish behavior or native acceptance, and partial care definitions cannot inherit an older build’s proof. Source-ready, source-applied, matching build, saved-state compatibility and playable evidence remain separate.

Preserve the useful consumer distinctions: a paid actual survey needs an actual recipient or material effect; knowledge-only output is not automatically a usable payoff. Same-loan held use is not a fresh loan, negative borrowed reservation or duplicated deposit refund. Learner-owned procedure, exact equipment/material support, current participants and completion facts, meaningful loaded versus fine work and received known-People introductions each need their actual owner. A service visible in Here does not prove the observer has met its provider or learned private accounts. A completed local operation does not itself grant every broader biology/time/AI/world feature.

WC-G1–WC-G5 and named missing consumers route this historical finite handoff. They are not current writer reservations, live worker evidence or permission to overwrite shared source. Later actual delivery may supersede old missing/held descriptions; inspect the selected current owner before declaring a new repair. Optional ACS/DLC/source depth remains useful separately from the finite finish. The old one-prestige scope and source-role deferred-check instruction do not supersede current direction or AD43 runtime completion. No linked incumbent trace, current source, private save, process, build or gameplay check was read or executed here.
